demoNote.en: Changes stay in this browser. No devices, payments, invitations or backend services are contacted.
demoNote.id: Perubahan hanya tersimpan di browser ini. Tidak menghubungi perangkat, pembayaran, undangan, atau layanan backend.

extra.en: Additional idea · not specified in PRD
extra.id: Ide tambahan · tidak dirinci di PRD

published.en: New revision created; awaiting device acknowledgement.
published.id: Revisi baru dibuat; menunggu acknowledgement perangkat.

reauthNote.en: This checkbox only demonstrates the re-authentication step; it does not verify identity.
reauthNote.id: Checkbox ini hanya memperagakan langkah autentikasi ulang; tidak memverifikasi identitas.

guard.en: Active sessions keep their immutable snapshot. Only new sessions use the new configuration. Hardware changes require explicit apply and a new preflight.
guard.id: Sesi aktif tetap memakai snapshot immutable. Hanya sesi baru yang memakai konfigurasi baru. Perubahan hardware memerlukan apply eksplisit dan preflight ulang.

range.en: Value is outside the permitted range.
range.id: Nilai berada di luar rentang yang diizinkan.

noChanges.id: Tidak ada perubahan pada perbandingan ini.

created.en: Record created as a local draft.

queued.en: Command recorded locally; execution and acknowledgement are pending.
queued.id: Perintah dicatat lokal; eksekusi dan acknowledgement masih menunggu.

retryNote.en: Only retryable jobs below the attempt limit are eligible. Reuse the same job and idempotency key. Conflict, active leases and dead-letter jobs are excluded.
retryNote.id: Hanya job retryable di bawah batas percobaan yang memenuhi syarat. Gunakan job dan kunci idempotensi yang sama. Konflik, lease aktif, dan dead-letter dikecualikan.

retryDone.en: Eligible jobs requeued locally. Attempts increase only when a worker executes them.
retryDone.id: Job aman diantrekan ulang lokal. Percobaan bertambah hanya saat worker mengeksekusi.

ledgerNote.en: Append-only ledger. Consume on the first successful still. Only a durable, contiguous backend acknowledgement can mark reconciliation complete; this console cannot edit transitions.
ledgerNote.id: Ledger append-only. Konsumsi pada still pertama yang berhasil. Hanya acknowledgement backend yang durable dan berurutan dapat menyelesaikan rekonsiliasi; console tidak dapat mengubah transisi.

offlineNote.en: New PAYG QRIS is never authorized offline. Offline admission requires valid cached signatures, event/device scope, clock, inventory and quota.
offlineNote.id: PAYG QRIS baru tidak pernah diotorisasi saat offline. Penerimaan offline memerlukan signature cache valid, cakupan acara/perangkat, waktu, inventori, dan kuota.

retentionNote.en: Never delete unuploaded media, unacknowledged ledgers or allocations, or templates referenced by sessions/reprints. Cleanup requires verified upload AND elapsed retention.
retentionNote.id: Jangan hapus media belum diunggah, ledger/alokasi belum diakui, atau template yang masih dirujuk sesi/reprint. Cleanup memerlukan unggahan terverifikasi DAN masa retensi selesai.

immutable.en: Published versions are immutable. Saving creates or updates a separate draft.
immutable.id: Versi terpublikasi immutable. Penyimpanan membuat atau memperbarui draf terpisah.

inviteNote.en: Invitation workflow is a proposed UI for PRD role management. No email is sent; TTL and approval options are examples.
inviteNote.id: Alur undangan adalah usulan UI pengelolaan peran PRD. Tidak ada email dikirim; TTL dan opsi persetujuan merupakan contoh.

printerNote.en: SENT means transport accepted, not proof of physical printing. A technical retry retains the existing print entitlement.
printerNote.id: SENT berarti diterima transport, bukan bukti cetak fisik. Retry teknis mempertahankan entitlement cetak yang sama.

ackNote.en: Test fixture only: online devices acknowledge their desired revision after successful validation. Offline devices remain pending.
ackNote.id: Hanya fixture pengujian: perangkat online mengakui revisi tujuan setelah validasi berhasil. Perangkat offline tetap menunggu.

error.en: This workspace could not be displayed. Try again.
error.id: Ruang kerja tidak dapat ditampilkan. Coba lagi.

localError.en: Browser storage is unavailable; changes will last only for this session.
localError.id: Penyimpanan browser tidak tersedia; perubahan hanya bertahan pada sesi ini.

validationNote.en: Local semantic checks only. Cryptographic signatures, asset hashes, hardware capabilities and canonical shared-schema validation still require backend/edge services.
validationNote.id: Hanya pemeriksaan semantik lokal. Signature kriptografi, hash aset, kapabilitas hardware dan validasi shared schema kanonis tetap memerlukan layanan backend/edge.

pendingCommands.id: Tidak ada perintah nyata yang dikirim.

applyNote.en: This records an explicit apply request. It does not operate hardware or replace a health check.
applyNote.id: Ini mencatat permintaan apply eksplisit. Tidak mengoperasikan hardware atau menggantikan pengecekan kesehatan.

effectiveNote.en: Precedence: platform defaults → device profile → event → campaign → audited on-site override. Null inherits; false and zero remain explicit values.
effectiveNote.id: Prioritas: default platform → profil perangkat → acara → kampanye → override di lokasi yang diaudit. Null mewarisi; false dan nol tetap nilai eksplisit.

guardrailError.en: This combination violates a safety rule. Check scope, dates, caps and references.
guardrailError.id: Kombinasi ini melanggar aturan keamanan. Periksa cakupan, tanggal, batas dan referensi.

healthHelp.en: Choose a device and scenario. Results are simulated, not live hardware measurements.
healthHelp.id: Pilih perangkat dan skenario. Hasil merupakan simulasi, bukan pengukuran hardware langsung.

guideCopy.en: Select a fleet scope, edit a draft, inspect the effective diff, validate, then simulate publishing. Verify each device acknowledgement before rollout completion.
guideCopy.id: Pilih cakupan perangkat, edit draf, tinjau perbedaan efektif, validasi, lalu simulasikan publikasi. Periksa acknowledgement setiap perangkat sebelum rollout selesai.

privacy.en: Guest identifiers and operational tokens remain masked.
privacy.id: Identitas tamu dan token operasional tetap disamarkan.

publishNeeds.en: Save and validate this exact draft before publishing.
publishNeeds.id: Simpan dan validasi draf ini sebelum publikasi.

expiresNote.en: Expired on-site overrides are excluded from effective preview.
expiresNote.id: Override di lokasi yang kedaluwarsa tidak disertakan dalam pratinjau efektif.

templatePreview.en: Schematic preview · not a final rendered output
templatePreview.id: Pratinjau skematis · bukan hasil render final

roleNote.en: Example role matrix. PRD requires scoped RBAC but does not prescribe this exact permission matrix. Server-side authorization is still required.
roleNote.id: Contoh matriks peran. PRD mewajibkan RBAC terbatas tetapi tidak menentukan matriks izin ini secara persis. Otorisasi server tetap diperlukan.

metricsNote.en: Only fixture-backed counters are shown. Capture latency, render latency, clock drift, CPU/memory and restart telemetry remain unconnected.
metricsNote.id: Hanya metrik dari fixture yang ditampilkan. Telemetri latensi capture/render, penyimpangan waktu, CPU/memori dan restart belum terhubung.

allocationNote.en: Draft requests do not mint, sign or replenish vouchers. Published requests await backend allocation; signed fixture counters are read-only.
allocationNote.id: Permintaan draf tidak mencetak, menandatangani atau menambah voucher. Permintaan terpublikasi menunggu alokasi backend; angka fixture bertanda tangan hanya-baca.

pendingPublish.en: Request saved; backend signing and delivery are pending.
pendingPublish.id: Permintaan tersimpan; penandatanganan dan pengiriman backend menunggu.

syncPending.en: Template command queued locally; active version remains unchanged.
syncPending.id: Perintah template diantrekan lokal; versi aktif tidak berubah.

backendBoundary.en: Local contract adapter · awaiting canonical backend schema
backendBoundary.id: Adapter kontrak lokal · menunggu schema backend kanonis

binaryNote.en: Uploaded bundles and image rendering are not implemented here. Asset, signature and renderer checks use explicit fixtures; semantic template checks inspect the selected local draft.
binaryNote.id: Unggahan bundle dan render gambar belum diimplementasikan di sini. Pemeriksaan aset, signature dan renderer memakai fixture eksplisit; pemeriksaan semantik meninjau draf lokal terpilih.

rolesScope.en: All permissions are constrained by event/device scope; sensitive actions additionally require server re-authentication.
rolesScope.id: Semua izin dibatasi cakupan acara/perangkat; aksi sensitif juga memerlukan autentikasi ulang server.

schemaFailure.en: Local schema/geometry is invalid. Fix the template draft before activation.
schemaFailure.id: Schema/geometri lokal tidak valid. Perbaiki draf template sebelum aktivasi.

sampleFailure.en: The selected failure fixture failed this check. Last-known-good stays active.
sampleFailure.id: Fixture kegagalan terpilih gagal dalam pemeriksaan ini. Last-known-good tetap aktif.

draftPreviewNote.en: Compared with the selected record or example baseline. Use Runtime configuration for the combined hierarchy preview.
draftPreviewNote.id: Dibandingkan dengan data terpilih atau baseline contoh. Gunakan Konfigurasi runtime untuk pratinjau hierarki gabungan.

templateGuard.en: Published template content is immutable. A changed bundle requires a new version; signing, binary validation and activation remain pending.
templateGuard.id: Konten template terpublikasi immutable. Bundle berubah memerlukan versi baru; penandatanganan, validasi biner dan aktivasi tetap menunggu.

copy.en: Manage the profiles that connect cameras, printers, storage, and time health to each edge device.
copy.id: Kelola profil yang menghubungkan kamera, printer, penyimpanan, dan kesehatan waktu untuk tiap perangkat edge.

copy.en: Set event windows, eligible devices, entitlement rules, guest session limits, and campaign branding.
copy.id: Atur window event, perangkat eligible, aturan entitlement, batas sesi guest, dan branding campaign.

copy.en: Versioned and immutable frame bundles shared by preview, digital output, video overlay, and print raster.
copy.id: Bundle frame berversi dan immutable yang dipakai preview, output digital, video overlay, dan raster print.

copy.en: Exclusive, signed offline inventory per device. Inspect readiness and append-only reconciliation evidence.
copy.id: Inventori offline eksklusif dan bertanda tangan per perangkat. Tinjau kesiapan dan bukti rekonsiliasi append-only.

copy.en: Track jobs that continue safely when the device reconnects: reconciliation, uploads, delivery, and analytics.
copy.id: Pantau job yang dapat berjalan aman saat perangkat tersambung kembali: reconciliation, upload, delivery, dan analytics.

copy.en: Review versioned drafts, effective snapshots, device acknowledgements, before/after diffs, and rollback points.
copy.id: Tinjau draft berversi, snapshot efektif, acknowledgement perangkat, diff before/after, dan titik rollback.

copy.en: Set controls that protect operational configuration without exposing guest media or credentials.
copy.id: Atur kontrol yang melindungi konfigurasi operasional tanpa mengekspos media guest atau credential.

copy.en: Session, payment, capture, print, upload and delivery health required by PRD §15. Counters reflect the local fixture, not live telemetry.
copy.id: Kesehatan sesi, pembayaran, capture, cetak, unggahan dan pengiriman sesuai PRD §15. Angka berasal dari fixture lokal, bukan telemetri langsung.

copy.id: Identitas tamu dan token operasional tetap disamarkan.

label.en: Public key fingerprint (example; never a private key)
label.id: Fingerprint public key (contoh; bukan private key)

label.en: Slots: id, sourceIndex, x, y, width, height, zIndex, fit, mask
label.id: Slot: id, sourceIndex, x, y, width, height, zIndex, fit, mask

label.en: Layers: asset, text, QR, shape or sticker (JSON)
label.id: Layer: aset, teks, QR, bentuk atau stiker (JSON)

invite.reference: §14 (RBAC); invitation UX is an additional idea

label.en: On-site override expiry (required for non-empty override)
label.id: Kedaluwarsa override lokasi (wajib jika override diisi)

copy.en: Identity, hardware profiles and per-device acknowledgements.
copy.id: Identitas, profil hardware dan acknowledgement per perangkat.

copy.en: Run eight admission checks before a new session.
copy.id: Jalankan delapan pemeriksaan sebelum sesi baru.

copy.en: Choose a device before reviewing retention and disk safety.
copy.id: Pilih perangkat sebelum meninjau retensi dan keamanan disk.

copy.en: Windows, eligibility, activation and guest experience.
copy.id: Jendela waktu, kelayakan, aktivasi dan pengalaman tamu.

copy.en: Scoped overrides without changing active session snapshots.
copy.id: Override terbatas tanpa mengubah snapshot sesi aktif.

copy.en: Quota, reserve TTL, consume milestone and offline safety.
copy.id: Kuota, TTL reservasi, tahap konsumsi dan keamanan offline.

copy.en: Immutable versions, logical slots and allowlisted placeholders.
copy.id: Versi immutable, slot logis dan placeholder allowlist.

copy.en: One coordinate space for digital, print, preview and motion.
copy.id: Satu koordinat untuk digital, cetak, pratinjau dan motion.

copy.en: Local validation and simulated edge activation checks.
copy.id: Validasi lokal dan simulasi pemeriksaan aktivasi edge.

copy.en: Request inventory for a single redemption authority.
copy.id: Minta inventori untuk satu otoritas penukaran.

copy.en: Inspect transitions without editing redemption history.
copy.id: Tinjau transisi tanpa mengedit riwayat penukaran.

copy.en: Verify cached configuration, hardware and signed inventory.
copy.id: Periksa konfigurasi cache, hardware dan inventori bertanda tangan.

copy.en: Prioritized work with stable idempotency keys.
copy.id: Job berprioritas dengan kunci idempotensi stabil.

copy.en: Inspect failures and record an escalation; no blind replay.
copy.id: Tinjau kegagalan dan catat eskalasi; tanpa retry sembarang.

copy.en: Bounded exponential backoff, full jitter and lease recovery.
copy.id: Backoff eksponensial berbatas, full jitter dan pemulihan lease.

copy.en: Inspect actual values and per-device desired/active revisions.
copy.id: Tinjau nilai aktual dan revisi tujuan/aktif per perangkat.

copy.en: Prepare a scoped rollback that preserves active sessions.
copy.id: Siapkan rollback terbatas yang mempertahankan sesi aktif.

copy.en: Actor, scope, reason and timestamps remain append-only.
copy.id: Pelaku, cakupan, alasan dan waktu tetap append-only.

copy.en: Review permissions and operator assignments.
copy.id: Tinjau izin dan penugasan operator.

copy.en: Masked identities, certificate lifecycle and pending commands.
copy.id: Identitas tersamar, siklus sertifikat dan perintah tertunda.

copy.en: Protect unreconciled data and referenced assets.
copy.id: Lindungi data belum direkonsiliasi dan aset yang dirujuk.

failure.en: Camera probe failed; verify the stable ID and adapter.
failure.id: Probe kamera gagal; periksa ID stabil dan adapter.

failure.en: Printer unavailable. Check transport; optional print may continue digitally.
failure.id: Printer tidak tersedia. Periksa transport; cetak opsional dapat dilanjutkan digital.

failure.en: Network unavailable; only authorized offline paths can continue.
failure.id: Jaringan tidak tersedia; hanya alur offline terotorisasi dapat dilanjutkan.

failure.en: Disk headroom is below policy; preserve unuploaded media.
failure.id: Ruang kosong disk di bawah kebijakan; lindungi media belum diunggah.

failure.en: PAYG QRIS blocked. Do not create an offline payment entitlement.
failure.id: PAYG QRIS diblokir. Jangan membuat entitlement pembayaran offline.

failure.en: Clock is untrusted; block new cached entitlement admission.
failure.id: Waktu tidak tepercaya; blokir penerimaan entitlement cache baru.

failure.en: Bundle invalid; retain last-known-good and retry sync.
failure.id: Bundle tidak valid; pertahankan last-known-good dan ulangi sinkronisasi.

failure.en: Desired revision has not been acknowledged.

failure.id: Tidak ada alokasi terikat perangkat yang valid.

failure.en: Cached event is outside its validity window or scope.
failure.id: Acara cache di luar masa berlaku atau cakupan.

failure.en: Local schema/geometry is invalid. Fix the template draft before activation.
failure.id: Schema/geometri lokal tidak valid. Perbaiki draf template sebelum aktivasi.

failure.id: Fixture kegagalan terpilih gagal dalam pemeriksaan ini. Last-known-good tetap aktif.
